clauses.original_excerpt: Service Provider shall indemnify Client against all losses without limit.
clauses.reason: Liability appears uncapped. Standard Indian commercial agreements cap direct liability at 12 months of fees paid.
clauses.suggested_rewrite: Each party shall indemnify the other only for direct, proven third-party claims, subject to an aggregate cap equal to fees paid in the preceding twelve (12) months.

clauses.original_excerpt: Client may terminate immediately without notice, whereas Service Provider may not terminate before 24 months.
clauses.reason: Asymmetric termination creates business continuity exposure without a breach cure window.
clauses.suggested_rewrite: Either party may terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days written notice, or for material breach remaining uncured fifteen (15) days after notice.
